2173-4423-4693-6491-8344.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-4423-4693-6491-8344.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-4423-4693-6491-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
You control three or more Islands.
2173-4423-4693-6491-8344.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

529-5641-7730-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

5254-5902-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5902-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

5968-6495-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
5968-6495-6888.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1745-4591-8089.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1981-2415-2511-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-5870.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7934.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

907-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

4364-6797-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-6797-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3755-6970-7060-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1496-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4863-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-5670-7399.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-7399.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2730-5987-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

5641-6824-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6824-7173.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3899-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1987-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1987-6991.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {2}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Hangarback Walker resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-3263-5256-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1988-2876-4050.notablePrerequisites: Elenda's power is at least 4 plus its commander tax.
1988-2876-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
Choose to return Elenda from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to its power.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Blade of the Bloodchief's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Elenda.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {W/B}.
When the Vampire dies, Elenda and Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting three +1/+1 counters on Elenda.
Repeat from step 6 for each Vampire token.
Repeat from step 1.
1988-2876-4050.notes: Once you have infinite Vampires and infinite mana, you can attach Blade of the Bloodchief to any creature you control and sacrifice Vampires to put +1/+1 counters on those creature(s).

628-997-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-997-6863--133.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
628-997-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

2034-2558-2829-3490.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4050-5544-6247-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, High-Society Hunter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

2608-4499-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Bloom Tender
Repeat.

1174-3573-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
1174-3573-6678.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat.

3204-4251-4364-6633.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4251-4364-6633.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Druid, adding {C}{C}.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1062-1414-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three land cards in hand.
1062-1414-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Slogurk's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G/U}.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Slogurk's third ability triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
27-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1354-1636-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least five untapped creatures, two of which must be green.
1354-1636-4113.description:
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by tapping five creatures you control, two of which must be green.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
When the Wurm enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4050-4242-5140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {B}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1741-1987-2493-2499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1741-1987-2493-2499.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries.
When Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Archaeomancer trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

3413-4050-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
